key_insight: MonteRET uses region-aware retrieval and knowledge-guided rewriting to make chest CT findings generation more complete and clinically faithful.
clinical_relevance: If validated in practice, this approach could help radiology workflows by reducing missed findings in autogenerated CT report drafts.
method: Combines global CT features with region-level anatomical representations.
Retrieves relevant clinical knowledge using predicted conditions plus region-level vision-language alignment.
Refines draft reports with a knowledge-guided rewriting agent.
evidence_signal: The model was trained on 24,128 RadGenome-ChestCT scans and evaluated on 1,564 public test scans plus 82 external scans, where it outperformed baselines and was preferred by radiology residents.
watch_item: As a retrospective AI system, it still needs prospective validation and careful checking for failure cases before clinical use.
paper_title: MonteRET: AI Agent Enhancing Multimodal LLMs with Multi-granularity Knowledge Retrieval for Chest CT Report Generation
